description: Defines the class interface for FramebufferGL, a class managing OpenGL framebuffer operations within the ANGLE project, including methods for clearing, reading pixels, blitting, and state synchronization.

classes.name: FramebufferGL
classes.description: A class implementing framebuffer operations for OpenGL in the ANGLE rendering backend.

methods.name: FramebufferGL
methods.description: Constructor initializing the framebuffer with state, ID, default status, and alpha emulation flag.

methods.name: ~FramebufferGL
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the framebuffer object within a given context.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Discards specified attachments to optimize performance.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates specified attachments.

methods.name: invalidateSub
methods.description: Invalidates a sub-region of attachments.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the framebuffer with specified mask.

methods.name: clearBufferfv
methods.description: Clears a buffer with float values.

methods.name: clearBufferuiv
methods.description: Clears a buffer with unsigned int values.

methods.name: clearBufferiv
methods.description: Clears a buffer with int values.

methods.name: clearBufferfi
methods.description: Clears depth and stencil buffers.

methods.name: getImplementationColorReadFormat
methods.description: Returns the color read format.

methods.name: getImplementationColorReadType
methods.description: Returns the color read type.

methods.name: readPixels
methods.description: Reads pixel data from the framebuffer.

methods.name: blit
methods.description: Performs blitting (copying) from source to destination rectangle.

methods.name: getSamplePosition
methods.description: Gets the position of a sample.

methods.name: shouldSyncStateBeforeCheckStatus
methods.description: Indicates if a full sync is required before checking status.

methods.name: checkStatus
methods.description: Checks the completeness status of the framebuffer.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes the framebuffer state with the context.

methods.name: getFramebufferID
methods.description: Returns the framebuffer's OpenGL ID.

methods.name: isDefault
methods.description: Checks if the framebuffer is the default framebuffer.

methods.name: hasEmulatedAlphaChannelTextureAttachment
methods.description: Checks if the framebuffer has an emulated alpha channel attachment.
